gameDescriptionHtml:
Thrae is a cozy crafting adventure game, where you play as a bunny on their path to become the legendary Easter Bunny! Build relationships, craft, decorate & deliver enchanted eggs to heal your friends of the forest!

Game Features

  • 2 – 4 Hours of Stress Free Gameplay
  • Craft & Decorate Magical Eggs – Craft, customize and deliver enchanted eggs to suit each NPC’s needs. Deep customization system with plenty of colors and patterns hidden around the world.
  • Explore a Diverse Landscapes – Journey through vibrant ecosystems, from lush forests to spooky swamp environments. Explore every corner of the map to find secret locations, rare resources, and bonus content.
  • Build Relationships and Unlock Rewards – Form meaningful bonds with 9 Unique NPC’s all with different stories to tell and requests. Interact with a choice driven narrative system that influences your standing within the animal community.
  • Outsmart sneaky traps – Neutralize traps by using toolkits to lock pick, or solving puzzles.
  • Engaging Puzzles and Challenges – Solve puzzles and mini games to unlock new paths, gather crafting materials, and discover hidden secrets. Use creativity and strategy to meet the unique challenges presented by the Thrae.
  • Foraging and Resource Collection – Search the world to gather essential resources like berries, twigs, and golden sap to craft magical eggs and quest items. Fish for Metal scraps to help clean the environment and craft tools to remove the Thrae’s traps from the region.
  • Uncover the Easter Bunny’s Mysteries – Learn the origin of the Easter Bunny and his magical eggs through captivating storylines.
  • Immersive Visuals and Original Soundtrack – Delight in a whimsical art style inspired by springtime nature and wildlife. Enjoy an enchanting original soundtrack that combines atmospheric melodies with regional musical influences.
